hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}}"; { t="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && case "$(git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath)" in .githooks|.githooks/|./.githooks|./.githooks/|"$t/.githooks"|"$t/.githooks/") ;; *) git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath .githooks;; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

for d in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/cursor-parity-notice.mjs" ]; then command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "$d/scripts/cursor-parity-notice.mjs"; fi; done; exit 0

for d in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/publishing-stop-guard.py" ]; then command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$d/scripts/publishing-stop-guard.py"; fi; done; exit 0
